001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * Formats events as <a href="http://ltsv.org">LTSV</a> (Labeled Tab-separated
009 * Values), one line of tab separated <code>label:value</code> fields per event,
010 * selected with the ltsv encoder scheme.
011 * <p>
012 * Each event is written as one line, for example (<code>⇥</code> is a tab):
013 * <code>time:2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z⇥level:INFO⇥logger:com.example.App⇥threadId:1⇥threadName:main⇥msg:hello world⇥requestId:42</code>
014 * <ul>
015 * <li>The labels are logfmt's field names. The thread fields are chosen with
016 * {@link ThreadFields}, by default <code>threadId</code> and
017 * <code>threadName</code>.</li>
018 * <li>The fields listed as columns (see {@link EventField}) come first, in the order
019 * listed and without labels, so they are read by position. With
020 * <code>columns=time,level,logger,thread,msg</code>:
021 * <code>2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z⇥INFO⇥com.example.App⇥1⇥main⇥hello world⇥requestId:42</code>.
022 * The fields not listed follow with their labels, before the key values. With
023 * <code>columns=thread,msg</code>:
024 * <code>1⇥main⇥hello world⇥time:2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z⇥level:INFO⇥logger:com.example.App⇥requestId:42</code>.
025 * Output with columns is no longer LTSV.</li>
026 * <li><code>time</code> is the UTC instant with milliseconds by default, and
027 * <code>timestamp</code> chooses another format or a DateTimeFormatter pattern in
028 * UTC, as for TTLL.</li>
029 * <li><code>level</code> is <code>TRACE</code>, <code>DEBUG</code>,
030 * <code>INFO</code>, <code>WARN</code>, or <code>ERROR</code>, unpadded by
031 * default.</li>
032 * <li>A field set to <code>none</code> is not written, and cannot be a column.</li>
033 * <li>The key values follow the fields, in order. A key value named like one of these
034 * fields is prefixed with <code>keyValues.</code>. A key value without a value is
035 * written with an empty one.</li>
036 * <li>A throwable adds <code>error</code> (its <code>toString()</code>) and
037 * <code>stacktrace</code>.</li>
038 * </ul>
039 * Values are never quoted. LTSV does not allow tab, newline, or carriage return in a
040 * value, so these and <code>\</code> are backslash escaped (<code>\t</code>,
041 * <code>\n</code>, <code>\r</code>, <code>\\</code>) and other control characters are
042 * written as <code>\</code><code>uXXXX</code>, so every event stays on one line.
043 * Characters LTSV does not allow in labels (anything but
044 * <code>A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -</code>) are percent-encoded as UTF-8 (<code>a b</code> is
045 * <code>a%20b</code>), and an empty key is <code>%</code>, so different keys stay
046 * different.
047 * <p>
048 * Values can be colored like the TTLL formatter; labels and <code>msg</code> are not.
049 * <code>error</code> and <code>stacktrace</code> take the level's color, since they
050 * are on the event's line.
051 * <table class="table">
052 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
053 * <tr>
054 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
055 * <th>Type</th>
056 * <th>Required</th>
057 * <th>Default</th>
058 * <th>Description</th>
059 * </tr>
060 * <tr>
061 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.timestamp" }</code></td>
062 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
063 * <td><code>true</code></td>
064 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.TimestampFormat#ISO iso}</td>
065 * <td>Time format, see {@link TTLL.TimestampFormat}; <code>default</code> is <code>iso</code>.</td>
066 * </tr>
067 * <tr>
068 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.thread" }</code></td>
069 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
070 * <td><code>true</code></td>
071 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}</td>
072 * <td>Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.</td>
073 * </tr>
074 * <tr>
075 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.level" }</code></td>
076 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
077 * <td><code>true</code></td>
078 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.LevelFormat#PLAIN plain}</td>
079 * <td>Level format, see {@link TTLL.LevelFormat}; <code>default</code> is <code>plain</code>.</td>
080 * </tr>
081 * <tr>
082 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.logger" }</code></td>
083 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
084 * <td><code>true</code></td>
085 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.LoggerFormat#FULL full}</td>
086 * <td>Logger name format, see {@link TTLL.LoggerFormat}.</td>
087 * </tr>
088 * <tr>
089 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.columns" }</code></td>
090 * <td><code>{@link LogProperties#listOrNull(String) List&lt;String&gt;}</code></td>
091 * <td><code>true</code></td>
092 * <td>none, so every field is labeled</td>
093 * <td>The fields written first without labels, see {@link EventField}.</td>
094 * </tr>
095 * <tr>
096 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.color" }</code></td>
097 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
098 * <td><code>false</code></td>
099 * <td><code>null</code></td>
100 * <td>Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.</td>
101 * </tr>
102 * <tr>
103 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.theme" }</code></td>
104 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
105 * <td><code>false</code></td>
106 * <td><code>null</code></td>
107 * <td>Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.</td>
108 * </tr>
109 * </table>
110 */
111public final class LtsvFormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<LtsvFormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {
112

121         */
122        static final String PROPERTY_timestamp = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "timestamp";
123        /**
124         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
125         */
126        static final String PROPERTY_thread = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "thread";
127        /**
128         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Level format, see {@link TTLL.LevelFormat}; <code>default</code> is <code>plain</code>.
129         */
130        static final String PROPERTY_level = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "level";
131        /**
132         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_logger } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter</code> Logger name format, see {@link TTLL.LoggerFormat}.
133         */
134        static final String PROPERTY_logger = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "logger";
135        /**
136         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_columns } = java.util.List</code> The fields written first without labels, see {@link EventField}.
137         */
138        static final String PROPERTY_columns = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "columns";
139        /**
140         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
141         */
142        static final String PROPERTY_color = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "color";
143        /**
144         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
145         */
146        static final String PROPERTY_theme = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "theme";
147        
148        private final String propertyPrefix;
149        final String property_timestamp;
150        final String property_thread;
151        final String property_level;
152        final String property_logger;
153        final String property_columns;
154        final String property_color;
155        final String property_theme;
156        
157        private final java.lang.String name;
158        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter timestamp = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.DEFAULT_TIMESTAMP;
159        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields.BOTH;
160        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter level = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.DEFAULT_LEVEL;
161        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter logger = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.DEFAULT_LOGGER;
162        private java.util.List<io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.EventField> columns = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.DEFAULT_COLUMNS;
163        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color = null;
164        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme = null;
165        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;

167        /**
168         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
169         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.ltsv.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
170         */
171        public LtsvFormatterBuilder(
172                        java.lang.String name
173                        ) {
174                try {
175                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
176                                        "name", name
177                                );
178                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
179                        this.name = name;
180                        property_timestamp = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_timestamp, prefixParameters);
181                        property_thread = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_thread, prefixParameters);
182                        property_level = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_level, prefixParameters);
183                        property_logger = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_logger, prefixParameters);
184                        property_columns = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_columns, prefixParameters);
185                        property_color = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_color, prefixParameters);
186                        property_theme = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_theme, prefixParameters);
187                }
188                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
189                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
190                }
191        }

291        /**
292         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter } from this builder.
293         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
294         */
295        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter build() {
296                try {
297                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.of(
298                                        this.name
299                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_timestamp, this.timestamp)
300                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_thread, this.thread)
301                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_level, this.level)
302                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_logger, this.logger)
303                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_columns, this.columns)
304                                        , this.color
305                                        , this.theme
306                                        , this.serviceRegistry
307                                        );
308                }
309                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
310                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
311                }
312        }
313        
314        @Override
315        public LtsvFormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
316                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
317                var _timestamp = properties.forKey(property_timestamp).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertTimestamp(_v)).or(this.timestamp).validate(__v);
318                var _thread = properties.forKey(property_thread).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertThread(_v)).or(this.thread).validate(__v);
319                var _level = properties.forKey(property_level).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertLevel(_v)).or(this.level).validate(__v);
320                var _logger = properties.forKey(property_logger).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertLogger(_v)).or(this.logger).validate(__v);
321                var _columns = properties.forKey(property_columns).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertColumns(_v)).or(this.columns).validate(__v);
322                var _color = properties.forKey(property_color).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertColor(_v)).or(this.color).validateIfError(__v);
323                var _theme = properties.forKey(property_theme).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatter.convertTheme(_v)).or(this.theme).validateIfError(__v);
324                __v.validate();
325                this.timestamp = _timestamp.value();
326                this.thread = _thread.value();
327                this.level = _level.value();
328                this.logger = _logger.value();
329                this.columns = _columns.value();
330                this.color = _color.valueOrNull();
331                this.theme = _theme.valueOrNull();
332                return this;
333        }

341                return this.propertyPrefix;
342        }
